title: Conditional kappa 0.001016469657190768: shared-donor chains with target re-synthesis
body:
Transfer PR402 target re-synthesis onto PR404 shared-donor chains: conditional **κ = 0.001016469657190768** (`63529353574423/62500000000000000`), **+0.00465719% over #404** (`0.001016422320428301`).

The two target paths 177 and 220 change `(3,5)` to `(6,2)`. Each delivery is relocated using its unique complete predecessor gate after #404's changed entrance and prefix chronology. The full raw operator remains identical on all 1021 columns, including all helper dirt. #404's 194 gauges, shared-donor chains, overlapping 124/125/172 target recovery and credited #376 target201 frame improvement are preserved.

We retain #404's original old-response/full-cleanup bracket and its eight-replica packing (738 banks per stage, 394 rank-one paddings). #403's packing gain is **not** added: #404 already attains the fixed residual-pattern packing bound. All newly needed Gaussian phases, both formal dirty orientations, exact chronological target-matrix identity, inverse routes, padding and scalar costs are freshly checked.

Complex lower: `203500783810111213217/200000000000000000000000`. Bit lower: `255384852701747/250000000000000000`. Live stock 14322, physical stock 15113, mass 1043010, deficit 2496. Recomputed local bound `7779885932526`, per-vertex bound `622357056395634`, row `15445 < 20161`.

- Full clean wrapper CI, Python 3.11 and 3.14: **queued**, [run 38128381678](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38128381678). Submitted as a draft before CI as requested; outputs are retained on failure.

Run `python -B research/e8-shared-donor-resynth/verify.py /tmp/shared-donor-resynth`. It freshly executes the entire immutable #404 supplier, then all changed checks and mandatory fresh bit replay. No supplier code is modified. All 154 original #404 files are included byte-for-byte under `research/e8-shared-donor-chains`, with raw Git-blob pins and byte-preserving attributes. #402 reconstruction bytes/designs are pinned in the inherited `e8-response-resynth-bank64/vendor402` package.

### Scope and credits

Inherited all-size window, arbitrary correlated-bank, recursive compiler, ordinary-call/fixed-tape, restored-row, common-grid, precision and analytic contracts remain assumptions. No unconditional multiplication exponent, global optimality or formal Lean proof is claimed.

The structural transfer, independent replay and freshly checked composition are by **Rohan Arun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, Apache-2.0.

Pins: #404 `12f488264cdd74a3b60d0fb534f4955792384f5c`; #402 `7883c63ec724999b921c2304b66648cbb9e7a112`. Parent #405 preserves prior work; its distinct bank64 result is not added here.

### Legacy-checker compatibility audit

After #407 reported legacy-checker rejections, we reproduced them independently. This word does **not** pass the unchanged `gx.check1`/`gxcore` pipeline: E4 rejects the inherited overlapping target dependency, and the fixed-sixths dirty replay rejects an intermediate quarter coefficient. The exact x-content and gauged-response checks pass separately. An independent rational replay over all1021 raw input columns finds denominator powers at most 2² and 3¹ (a common denominator12), with maximum absolute coefficient4; this observation covers the raw main word, not an all-size compiler theorem.

Our finite admission deliberately uses the exact chronological120-column target identity in place of the disjoint-role E4 sufficient condition, and charges literal HALVE/DIVIDE3 operations in the dyadic/divisor3 framework (`odd_grid = 2^(-P)3^(-G(D+1))`). Both full formal dirty orientations are checked directly. These facts do not turn the result into a legacy gx/Lean certificate: the already stated all-size compiler, common-grid and precision interfaces remain conditional. Comparisons with #407's checker-clean construction must retain this distinction.
